method: Curator-targeted study-level comparison, several original fulltexts and publisher abstracts, not complete from 1061 corpus.

source_rows.sample: 35 original ACC-classified bird tags, 193088 common 15min bins, 17 heldout weeks
source_rows.tide: real measured harbor stage vs +3/+7/+11-day wrong-stage ghosts
source_rows.solar: GPS astronomical day/night plus clock harmonics
source_rows.core_finding: correct tide MSE 0.128819 vs best wrong 0.148567, solar baseline 0.198869; selected retrospectively after v129
source_rows.reason_no_pool: one same site, behavioral classifier and outcome-specific CV only

source_rows.sample: 35 analyzable GPS+ACC juveniles (10 Tagus,25 Ria Formosa), one original paper two separate wetlands
source_rows.observation: ACC-classified feeding vs other GPS event proportion
source_rows.core_finding: Tagus feeding diel more influential and rice fields used; Ria Formosa feeding tide×diel interaction most supported
source_rows.reason_no_pool: two wetlands one study, different tag effort/duty and within-site AIC delta not standardized effect

source_rows.sample: 2019 volunteers survey two sites in same lagoon, Feb-Apr peak spawning
source_rows.observation: count of spawning crabs negative binomial model
source_rows.core_finding: wind and onshore direction predict counts; tide not strongly supported in global model
source_rows.reason_no_pool: not tidal×solar; tide measurement scaling and endpoint differ from GPS ACC/marsh studies

source_rows.sample: 13 initially tagged, 6 fish retained in acoustic receiver coverage during 40-day 2003 study
source_rows.core_finding: population best model date+diel, tide excluded; 3 of 6 fish individual best fits include tide or interaction
source_rows.reason_no_pool: one bay and six fish, group time vs tide predictor AIC not same quantity as CV skill

source_rows.sample: 18 adult acoustic-accelerometry tagged crabs in one creek
source_rows.tide: local ebb/flood and stage, approx 2m tidal range
source_rows.core_finding: foraging more likely low/incoming tide, inactivity 79% classified time; hour of day removed from selected model
source_rows.reason_no_pool: HMM state probability, unknown independent source SE and not common metric

source_rows.sample: 1-year intertidal sampling of juvenile snook in macrotidal mangrove creeks
source_rows.observation: intertidal count and stomach fullness proxy
source_rows.core_finding: juvenile abundance highest neap-night vs lowest spring-day; stomach fullness highest neap night and low neap day
source_rows.reason_no_pool: no standardized effect+SE extracted, stomach fullness and abundance distinct endpoints

source_rows.sample: one Humble Island penguin colony over ten seasons; 2011 11 tags 738h diving observations
source_rows.observation: foraging spatial location vs tidal current regime
source_rows.tide: diurnal vs semidiurnal current-regime switching on weekly scale, not simple daily tide phase
source_rows.solar: diel timing not the estimated primary contrast
source_rows.core_finding: penguin foraging locations shift with regime switching, not daily high/low-tide cycles
source_rows.reason_no_pool: different timescale and spatial endpoint; no compatible independent effect+SE

source_rows.taxa: marsh snails, crabs, conchs, marsh plants
source_rows.sample: controlled field predator exposure experiment and natural marshes spanning ~400km
source_rows.observation: snail grazing and marsh plant biomass; predation and antipredator behavior
source_rows.tide: diurnal versus mixed semidiurnal local regime
source_rows.solar: diel by astronomical daylight not factorially measured
source_rows.core_finding: indirect predator effects on grazing reverse with tidal regime while direct predator effects remain; across-coast field patterns align
source_rows.reason_no_pool: tide regime natural experiment with plant biomass not individual activity and shared study

source_rows.sample: camera traps over more than five years on one island
source_rows.observation: coastal camera photographic activity tool-use group
source_rows.tide: tide sourced from distant approx 90km station
source_rows.core_finding: tool-using group shows stronger tidal activity association than non-tool-using groups
source_rows.reason_no_pool: distant tide proxy, camera detectability and behavioral covariation

source_rows.sample: 46 wild crabs, two life stages at same beach
source_rows.observation: day/night emergence and alongshore/intertidal zonation + behavior budget
source_rows.tide: tidal intertidal zone, explicit tide phase predictor not established
source_rows.core_finding: juveniles use higher intertidal elevations and emerge more at night, temporal×space partition of life stages
source_rows.reason_no_pool: not a tidal phase effect, spatial partition doesn't alone establish competitive coexistence

source_rows.sample: coexisting FM and NM genetic timing strains, source larvae and field phenology
source_rows.observation: reproductive emergence lunar phase, oviposition waterline, larval genotype by elevation
source_rows.solar: lunar/tidal reproductive clock, 24h solar independent contribution not tested
source_rows.core_finding: emergence timing changes waterline/elevation of eggs and larvae; coexistence consequence is model-supported
source_rows.reason_no_pool: not direct tide-vs-diel predictive loss and coexistence model not independent second field source

source_rows.taxa: Charadrius melodus, C. nivosus, C. wilsonia
source_rows.observation: mudflat plover count, Poisson tide model conditional centered wind
source_rows.core_finding: three species mudflat count tide coefficients negative but share same independent coast
source_rows.reason_no_pool: no night period; three species one coast and related correlated sampling

source_rows.sample: 20 satellite-tagged black oystercatchers, four nested coastal regions
source_rows.observation: habitat selection vs tide and diel strata
source_rows.core_finding: use of intertidal foraging area and refuge depends on tide and light; nested regions must not count as independent studies
source_rows.reason_no_pool: one study with nested regions and no common effect+SE from matched model

source_rows.observation: distance from low-tide roost, periodicity by individual
source_rows.core_finding: tidal rhythm 88% of birds, daily rhythm 57%, both 52%; no unified tide-specific forecast against ghost
source_rows.reason_no_pool: periodicity fraction not a conditional GLM coefficient and Wadden coast shared with other studies

source_rows.sample: ATLAS 2018–2022 sample bird-year counts 36,23,7,24,18 (not proven unique birds)
source_rows.observation: low-tide movement patches and spatial overlap day vs night
source_rows.core_finding: at night patches more persistent and closer to roost, day vs night range overlap asymmetric 20%/41%
source_rows.reason_no_pool: only low-tide conditional not tide-vs-solar effect; original observations available on author request
